title: Consecutive-block permutation Bessel hierarchy
statement: For every unit-diagonal symmetric matrix with invertible permutation triangular factors, the consecutive-block projection matrices satisfy 0 <= K_2 <= K_3 <= ... <= K_n = E[M_pi^{-T}M_pi^{-1}]. The fixed-depth assertion K_q >= 2 P_ker is not part of this claim.
assumptions: Every M_pi is invertible; unit triangular correlation factors satisfy this
K_q uses the scalar L2 orthogonal projection tensored with the output identity
open_objections: Needs hostile audit and independent reconstruction
No fixed-depth lower bound sufficient for T080 has been proved
The q=3 n=10 route counterexample is Monte Carlo rather than exact
